svg.title: Federal Budget Process Timeline
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the supplied FY 2028 timeline. Agency submission uses typical September timing. Execution is conditional on enacted authority and continues beyond this chart.

text.tspan: Key Activities, Responsible Parties, and Typical Dates — Illustrative Fiscal Year 2028
Strategic planning and estimates → typical September submission → revisions and appeals
Spring guidance → fall review → passback decisions → executive budget proposal
Budget proposal received by early February; committee and floor activity follows. Enactment timing varies.
Enactment and availability are prerequisites. Execution and oversight continue through
Program authority and additional appropriations follow their applicable legislative processes.
Reallocations, proposals, enacted cancellations, and required approvals retain their distinct status.
Recoveries and statutory reductions depend on the specific authority and legal context.
Consolidated and clarified content from the supplied screenshot. Typical September submission replaces its August 1–15 assumption; execution is placed after enacted authority.
Dates are illustrative, not an official FY 2028 calendar. Sources: OMB Circular A–11 (2025), §10; 31 U.S.C. §1105. February 1, 2027 is the first Monday in February.
